{{Quote|I was in a bacta tank the last time Daeruun brewed this tea of his. I want to see what all the fuss is about.|Gnost-Dural, to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="Onslaught" />}}
'''Gatalentan tea''' was a type of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gatalenta/Legends|Gatalenta]]<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> that was potable by [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="Lockin" /> [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dors]],<ref name="Onslaught" /> and [[Krex]]. During the [[third Galactic War]]<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> in [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Date 5.10">{{TOR_updates|5.10.0}}</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], who favored the tea, had been told that the tea could only be appreciated if shared.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

In [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">The mention of the gatalentan [[Tea/Legends|tea]] and the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|battle]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] took place during the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' expansion, which according to {{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} takes place in [[3627 BBY]].</ref> General Daeruun, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], and the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] were set to depart from the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']] to the planet of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|engage]] with forces from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Before departing, Daeruun mentioned to the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] that the travel would be long enough to allow him to cook [[Ryshcate/Legends|ryshcate]] and prepare a pot of Gatalentan tea. Gnost-Dural replied that he was interested in having some tea to see what the commotion was behind it, as he was in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] the last time Daeruun brewed it.<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I'll have a case sent to you&mdash;the flavor is unmatched, though I'm told it can only truly be appreciated when shared.|Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun, to the Alliance Commander|audio=DaeruunTea.flac|<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />}}
Gatalentan tea was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically in the<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> [[2018]]<ref name="JUS Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181211-0|text='Jedi Under Siege' Update – Play Now!}}</ref> ''Jedi Under Siege'' update for the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion. The tea is only mentioned if the player's character, known [[in-universe]] as the Alliance Commander, is among the character classes originally aligned with the Republic.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> [[Gatalentan tea]] was originally introduced in the [[2016]] [[canon]] novel [[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']], written by [[Claudia Gray]].<ref name="Bloodline">[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']]</ref>

During a conversation with General Daeruun in ''The Old Republic'', the [[Commanding officer/Legends|Commander]] can mention liking or disliking tea, depending on the player's choices. If the player expresses interest in the beverage, Daeruun will promise to send the Commander a case of Gatalentan tea.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> Choosing that option makes a letter from [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]] become available after completing the ''Jedi Under Siege'' storyline. In the letter, Lokin states he would like to share Gatalentan tea with the Commander.<ref name="Lockin" />

In ''The Dantooine Incursion'' update for ''The Old Republic'',<ref name="Daeruun Mail">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=message|Bravo!|General A. D. Daeruun}}</ref> released in [[2019]],<ref name="TDI Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190604|text=Game Update 5.10.3 "The Dantooine Incursion" is Live!}}</ref> if the Commander is not a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the reconstituted Sith Empire and if a [[Republic News Network]] interview with the Commander boosts the morale in Republic, Daeruun sends the character a letter. In it, the General congratulates the Commander and invites the character to drink Gatalentan tea with him.<ref name="Daeruun Mail" />
